summary: Saint John, beloved disciple, carried the message of divine love. His gospel and letters remain a fountain of contemplation and hope.
antiphon_text: Let us remember Saint John the Apostle as a faithful witness to the love and mercy of Christ.
prayer_text: Lord God, through the life of Saint John the Apostle, strengthen us to follow your path with courage and charity. Grant us the grace to bear faithful witness in our own time. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.
